svg.title: Flex distributes along one axis. Grid places into two.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Flex distributes along one axis. Grid places into two.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. The box model drawn as four nested rectangles from margin down to content, a specificity scoreboard scoring #nav .item a as 1-1-1 against a.item as 0-1-1 with !important crossed out, five flex cards wrapping along a single main axis beside a three-by-two grid whose container decides the placement, and a style-layout-paint-composite pipeline with measured layout times for 5000 items.
svg.text: Flex distributes along one axis. Grid places into two.
